notes: v6.6.2 — Fix three CI deployment failures. (1) i18n-db.mjs: better-sqlite3 native module segfaults on CI runners (Netlify/Cloudflare/GitHub Actions) due to ABI mismatch — segfault kills the process instantly and cannot be caught. Added isCI() detection and validateJsonOnly() fallback: on CI, translation validation runs purely on JSON files (key parity + empty-value + typo checks) without importing the native module. Dynamic import of better-sqlite3 ensures it is never loaded on CI. (2) build-ios.yml: GitHub Actions rejects `secrets` context in step-level if conditionals ('Unrecognized named-value: secrets'). Moved secret availability check to job-level env (HAS_IOS_CERT) and branched on env.HAS_IOS_CERT instead. (3) Verified GitHub Pages + APK build succeeds; Netlify/Cloudflare/iOS builds now expected to pass.
